roster.name: Tianhe
roster.note: The core module — living quarters, life support, propulsion, and the station's control center. The first piece launched, and the heart of the station.

roster.name: Chinarm
roster.note: The station’s robotic arm, mounted on Tianhe, used to relocate modules and assist spacewalks.

roster.name: Wentian
roster.note: The first laboratory module — with a backup control center and an airlock for spacewalks.

roster.name: Mengtian
roster.note: The second laboratory module, completing the T-shaped station; a facility for microgravity science.
first uncrewed Shenzhou test flight — the proof that China could fly its own crew capsule

roster.name: Shenzhou 5
roster.note: Yang Liwei becomes the first Chinese astronaut in orbit — China joins the US and USSR as the third nation to launch a human on its own rocket

roster.name: Shenzhou 9 → Tiangong-1
roster.note: first crewed docking with a Chinese station; Liu Yang becomes China's first woman in space

roster.name: Continuous occupation
roster.note: permanent crewing begins with Shenzhou-14 in June 2022; the CSS has been continuously crewed ever since
